The moving averages suggest that the stock is in a neutral trend. The MACD is also neutral, but it is trending downwards. The RSI is in the oversold territory, but it is starting to trend upwards. The Fibonacci retracement shows that the stock price is currently at the 61.8% retracement level. The Bollinger Bands show that the stock price is currently above the upper Bollinger Band.

Overall, the technical analysis is mixed. The stock price is in a neutral trend, but the MACD is trending downwards and the RSI is in the oversold territory. The Fibonacci retracement shows that the stock price is currently at the 61.8% retracement level. The Bollinger Bands show that the stock price is currently above the upper Bollinger Band.

I would recommend waiting for more confirmation before making a decision on whether to buy or sell this stock.
